title: Shame on the manufacturer.
text:
Shame on the manufacturer.. I bought this to use with the two Twin XL adjustable beds we bought ([[ASIN:B074QWYM22 LUCID L300 Adjustable Bed Base-5 Minute Assembly-Dual USB Charging Stations Head and Foot Incline-Wireless Remote Control-Upholstered-Ergonomic, Twin XL, Charcoal]] - good news is the beds do fit, very (very) snugly. As other reviewers have mentioned, using this as just a frame requires removing the slat rails on the sides, and just omitting the slats and center supports altogether. The look of the headboard and frame is nice, though putting it together, you see up-close that the materials used are pretty cheap.

The two main reasons I am giving this just 2 stars - and they are important reasons! - are: #1 - the holes are drilled in the wrong places on the legs to the headboard. You cannot install the cross bar AND the sides to the frame - the holes are simply in the wrong places to do both. Of course we chose to install the sides to the frame, since we're not actually placing any weight on this headboard and frame. But if we were, I would be livid, since the center supports rely on being screwed to the crossbar to support the slats, and ultimately, a bed. I mean, this would be completely USELESS as it was sent to me for use as a bed. Reason #2 - nearly every hinge where I needed to connect pieces was totally bent. I needed to use a clamp and a lot of muscle so I could straighten the hinges and screw them flush to the other part of the frame. Assembly was SUCH a frustrating experience because it was just poorly made. Shame on the manufacturer.
